The Perfect 5 Day Dolomite Itinerary!🏔️

📍SAVE to plan your Italian Dolomite Road Trip

✨Day 1
- hike Cadini di Misurina (2 miles, moderate)
- hike Tre Cime di Lavaredo (6 miles, moderate)
- Stay near Dobbiaco

✨Day 2
- Visit Lago di Braies (you can take a bus from Dobbiaco)
- Drive to Cortina d’Ampezzo, get some gelato and shop 

✨Day 3
- Hike Lago di Sorapis (7.5 miles, hard)

✨Day 4
- Take the cable car to Seceda
- Stop by Church of St John
- Walk to the St Magdalena viewpoint (30 min each way)

✨Day 5
- Walk to view Alpe di Siusi (1 hour each way) or take the cable car from Ortisei

🚐Renting a Van
- I rented a van with @roadsurfer out of Venice! (hosted)
- Most campgrounds don’t take reservations so I recommend often getting your spot early in the afternoon and then going out for the afternoon/evening activities 
- Hotels here are very expensive, so this will save you money, as it’s your hotel and rental car in one. Campgrounds usually charge by person and we’re usually around €50

title: 5-Day Dolomites Road Trip Itinerary
one_liner: A day-by-day Dolomites itinerary covering top hikes, sights, and van rental tips.
key_points: Days 1–3 focus on iconic hikes: Cadini di Misurina, Tre Cime di Lavaredo, Lago di Braies, and the hard 7.5-mile Lago di Sorapis trail
Days 4–5 cover scenic highlights: Seceda cable car, Church of St John, St Magdalena viewpoint, and Alpe di Siusi
Renting a van (e.g. Roadsurfer out of Venice) saves money vs. expensive hotels — campgrounds run ~€50/night per group
Most campgrounds don't take reservations, so arrive early afternoon to secure a spot before evening activities
